author_known_issues.heading: Warnings, Precautions, and Limitations
author_known_issues.text: ## Warnings and precautions - Use the loci file version that matches the reference genome passed to --ref. - Haplotagged input is recommended. author_known_issues.heading: Known limitations
author_known_issues.text: - When the original BAM contains many non-spanning reads, `DP` can be lower than an allele's `AD` or the sum of `AD`. `DP` measures mean alignment depth over the reference repeat interval, whereas `AD` counts reads selected for allele-length estimation, including selected non-spanning reads. This difference does not by itself indicate an invalid call. - Expansions supported mainly by non-spanning reads may be underestimated and sized less precisely than fully spanned alleles. - Apparent interruptions may be sequencing errors. Visual verification using the read visualisation is recommended. - I

author_known_issues.heading: Troubleshooting and Support
author_known_issues.text: For help, contact Oxford Nanopore Technologies through your usual support channel: [Oxford Nanopore customer support](https://nanoporetech.com/support/customer-support). ## Common checks - Confirm that the reference genome matches the loci file. - Confirm that the BAM or CRAM file is readable and indexed. - Confirm that the sample sex argument is correct. - Confirm that the input BAM is haplotagged unless --bypass-haplotag-check is intentionally being used. ## Common problems and messages | Message or issue | Likely cause | Suggested action | |------------------------|------------------------|
